thread:
mira: Noticing a small eviction spike in ap-south1 since ~11:05 UTC. A lot of 1g jobs bouncing, larger 8g jobs unaffected.

jon: Any infra maintenance?

mira: No scheduled. Metrics show brief node NotReady flaps clustered to rack-12, plus NIC retransmit up.

ops-bot: alert: ap-south1 rack-12 fabric-err-rate 0.8% (5m).

lucas: We pushed a NIC driver update to rack-12 and rack-15 at 10:50. Rack-15 looks fine; rack-12 shows elevated retransmits.

mira: Hypothesis: NIC resets cause kubelet to temporarily lose device/cgroup and emit DiskPressure eviction events even though disk is fine. Leads scheduler to reschedule small pods and fragment bins.

jon: Quick mitigations: (1) taint rack-12 nodes with no-small-gpu=true:NoSchedule, (2) increase tiny-job controller backoff to 20s.

mira: Applying taint now: kubectl taint nodes -l rack=ap-south1-r12 no-small-gpu=true:NoSchedule --overwrite

lucas: I'll prepare rollback of driver on rack-12 if metrics don't recover in 20m. Cost note: rollback will cause ~1 rack maintenance reserve.

ops-bot: note: runbook created: runbooks/infra/driver-rollback-ap-south1 by lucas

mira: Evictions dropped ~60% after taint+backoff. Leaving taint for 2h while we validate. Will follow up with a short retro in #postmortems.
